unlock-pdf.formula:
unlocked = save(decrypt(bytes, password))

PDFDocument.load(bytes, { password }) decrypts every object stream with your password. save() then writes the document without an encryption dictionary, so no password is asked again. Example: 5-page statement + correct password → 5-page unlocked PDF, byte-identical content.
